question: According to Table 1 (Page 5), what scores and approximate percentiles did GPT-4 (with vision) and GPT-3.5 achieve on GRE Quantitative, GRE Verbal, and GRE Writing?
expected_answer: In Table 1 (Page 5), on GRE Quantitative, GPT-4 achieved 163 / 170 (~80th percentile) vs GPT-3.5 at 147 / 170 (~25th percentile); on GRE Verbal, GPT-4 achieved 169 / 170 (~99th percentile) vs GPT-3.5 at 154 / 170 (~63rd percentile); and on GRE Writing, both GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 achieved 4 / 6 (~54th percentile).

gold.unit_and_condition: Scaled scores (/170 and /6) and percentiles in Table 1.

answer:
GRE Quantitative: GPT‑4 (with vision) scored 163 / 170 (~80th percentile) and GPT‑3.5 scored 147 / 170 (~25th percentile) [gpt4-2023-techreport_p005_table_01][gpt4-2023-techreport_p005_text_01].
GRE Verbal: GPT‑4 (with vision) scored 169 / 170 (~99th percentile) and GPT‑3.5 scored 154 / 170 (~63rd percentile) [gpt4-2023-techreport_p005_table_01][gpt4-2023-techreport_p005_text_01].
GRE Writing: GPT‑4 (with vision) scored 4 / 6 (~54th percentile) and GPT‑3.5 also scored 4 / 6 (~54th percentile) [gpt4-2023-techreport_p005_table_01][gpt4-2023-techreport_p005_text_01].

results.text:
[CHART: Figure 4 | Page 6 | BBox (45, 55, 565, 430)]
- Figure 4 Title: Exam results (ordered by GPT-3.5 performance) — GPT performance on academic and professional exams.
- X-axis: Exams ordered from low to high based on GPT-3.5 performance (from AP Calculus BC, AMC 12, Codeforces Rating up to SAT EBRW, AP Environmental Science).
- Y-axis: Estimated percentile lower bound among test takers (0% to 100%). Legend: gpt-4 (dark green), gpt-4 no vision (light green), gpt3.5 (blue).
- Artifact explanation in caption: Reporting the conservative lower bound of percentile bins creates artifacts on AP exams with wide scoring bins — for example, although GPT-4 attains the highest possible score on AP Biology (5/5), it is shown in the plot as 85th percentile because 15% of test-takers achieve a 5.

[CHART: Figure 6 | Page 10 | BBox (60, 310, 550, 610)]
- Figure 6 Title: Internal factual eval by category — Performance of GPT-4 on nine internal adversarially-designed factuality evaluations.
- X-axis (9 categories): learning, technology, writing, history, math, science, recommendation, code, business.
- Y-axis: Accuracy (0% to 80%, where 1.0/100% means agreement with human ideal responses for all questions).
- Legend / Series compared: chatgpt-v2, chatgpt-v3, chatgpt-v4 (all based on GPT-3.5) vs gpt-4 (green).
- Key quantitative result: GPT-4 scores 19 percentage points higher overall than the latest GPT-3.5 model, achieving ~75-80% across categories.

Table 1. GPT performance on academic and professional exams. In each case, we simulate the conditions and scoring of the real exam. We report GPT-4’s final score graded according to exam- specific rubrics, as well as the percentile of test-takers achieving GPT-4’s score.

Table 2: Performance of GPT-4 on traditional academic benchmarks (Columns: Benchmark | GPT-4 | GPT-3.5 | LM SOTA few-shot | Best external SOTA incl. benchmark-specific tuning):
- MMLU (57 subjects): GPT-4 (5-shot) = 86.4%; GPT-3.5 (5-shot) = 70.0%; LM SOTA (5-shot U-PaLM) = 70.7%; SOTA (5-shot Flan-PaLM) = 75.2%.
- HellaSwag: GPT-4 (10-shot) = 95.3%; GPT-3.5 (10-shot) = 85.5%; LM SOTA (LLaMA val) = 84.2%; SOTA (ALUM) = 85.6%.
- AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC Challenge-set): GPT-4 (25-shot) = 96.3%; GPT-3.5 (25-shot) = 85.2%; LM SOTA (8-shot PaLM) = 85.2%; SOTA (ST-MOE) = 86.5%.
- WinoGrande: GPT-4 (5-shot) = 87.5%; GPT-3.5 (5-shot) = 81.6%; LM SOTA (5-shot PaLM) = 85.1%; SOTA = 85.1%.
- HumanEval (Python coding): GPT-4 (0-shot) = 67.0%; GPT-3.5 (0-shot) = 48.1%; LM SOTA (0-shot PaLM) = 26.2%; SOTA (CodeT + GPT-3.5) = 65.8%.
- DROP (F1 score, reading comprehension & arithmetic): GPT-4 (3-shot) = 80.9; GPT-3.5 (3-shot) = 64.1; LM SOTA (1-shot PaLM) = 70.8; SOTA (QDGAT) = 88.4. (DROP is the only dataset in Table 2 where GPT-4 does not beat benchmark-specific SOTA).
- GSM-8K (grade-school math): GPT-4 (5-shot chain-of-thought, part of training set in pre-training mix) = 92.0%; GPT-3.5 (5-shot) = 57.1%; LM SOTA (8-shot Minerva) = 58.8%; SOTA (Chinchilla + SFT + ORM-RL) = 87.3%.
